name: io.github.andquemori/strata-b2a-mcp
title: STRATA & TrashPan B2A Public Data, KYB, TCG Market & Golf EV MCP Server
description: Zero-PII B2A 2-Story Remote MCP Server (15 streams, 52 tools). Free 1st Floor probe_inventory & tools/list ($0, no API key); 2nd Floor via X-MCP-API-Key, x402 Base USDC, or Apify Store PPE.

headers.name: X-MCP-API-Key
headers.description: Optional for 1st Floor (tools/list and probe_inventory are 100% free without key). Required only for 2nd Floor paid full data execution.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key for 2nd Floor full data calls. Leave empty to use Free 1st Floor tools/list and probe_inventory.
